_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Twelve individually reviewed historical Ghana and Tanzania drug-case convictions; later reversals and acquittals are excluded. Status is a documented historical disposition as of its source date, not a claim of current custody. Case organizations are evidence containers, not inferred relationships. No operational detail, precise/live location, or unlicensed portrait is included.
